findings.title: Where the error lives
findings.read: Volume is the larger source of error (51.74 yds from volume vs 45.4 from rate). Fix the volume model first; tuning the other half cannot recover this.

findings.title: Volume bias
findings.read: We under-project attempts by 0.04 per player (projected 31.79, actual 31.83).

findings.title: Rate bias
findings.read: yards per attempt is over-projected by 0.02 (projected 7.2, actual 7.18).

findings.title: Opponent adjustment is costing accuracy
findings.read: Error with the adjustment 62.46, without it 61.46. Removing it would be more accurate on this sample.

findings.title: Against the closing line
findings.read: Beat the line on 107/275 (38.91%). Our MAE 61.81 vs the line's 56.53. The book is the better projection.
